notes.title: New Update: UI and Gameplay Enhancements
notes.content:
Enemy:
Stealth Enemy: Appears every 5 levels and can only be detected using the Stealth Tower(Radiant Shrine)

Tower:
Radiant Shrine (Stealth Tower): A new tower that reveals Stealth Enemies, ensuring they can be targeted.

Other Adjustments:
Tower Balancing: Both the prices and damage of towers have been adjusted to improve overall game balance.

notes.title: UPDATE
notes.content:
Workers:
The game now pauses when the Inn panel is open.
Worker carry capacity can now be upgraded.
Additional information about workers is now available.

Spell Book:
New UI for easier readability.
The game pauses when the Spell Book is open.

Boss:
A boss with increased speed and HP will now spawn every 5 levels.

Enemies:
Six new enemies have been added.
Each enemy now has more animations.

Towers:
Two new towers added: the Sniper Tower and the God Tower.

Secret Codes:
Secret codes have been removed.

Marketplace:
Redesigned marketplace for a better trading overview.

Leaderboard:
Leaderboard are now included in the game.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
"Fixed a bug on the map that prevented players from building more towers when it should have been possible. Now, you can construct additional towers without any issues.

Also, added a 'Spawn' button next to the countdown timer. This allows you to spawn waves instantly instead of waiting, making the game more responsive and convenient."
